package.name: chase_train
package.description:
The single TD3 trainer whose flags produce the three arms -- faithful DDPG [C verbatim], repaired DDPG, TD3 (rl_training_guide.md 13.5) -- plus replay buffer with demonstration prefill, exploration noise with the verified keras-rl OU semantics, the auditable checkpoint bundle with ONNX export, the arms-x-seeds run matrix, and an SB3 cross-check.
Pure Python, no ROS imports (guide 15). Pip deps without rosdep keys: torch (verified 2.13.0), gymnasium, stable-baselines3 (optional, cross-check only), onnx + onnxruntime (optional, export only).
